code_a_label: 4C (write a YAML input file and run the 4C binary)
interface: the line x = 5/8, where the two materials meet
mesh_text: uniform meshes, h halved per level: h = 1/8, 1/16, 1/32
probe_iface: the 44 points (x, y) = (5/8, 1/4 + (i+0.5)*1/2/44) for i = 0, 1, ..., 43. These cover the INTERIOR of the interface only: where the interface meets the outer boundary the split problem has a Dirichlet-Neumann corner, the recovered flux there does not converge under refinement, and those points are therefore not graded
iface_clearance_reason: the interface ends are Dirichlet-Neumann corners of the split problem; the recovered flux there does not converge under refinement, so grading them would fail a correct submission
evidence_grade_reason: exact manufactured solution: proves the answer is CORRECT
graded_against: hidden manufactured solution (true error) AND reference-free mesh halving
equation: -div(k grad u) = f in each subdomain
coefficients: thermal conductivity k = 1 in subdomain A; thermal conductivity k = 200 in subdomain B
interface_condition: the field and its normal flux
element: Lagrange P1 elements in both codes
bc_text: u = 0 on the entire outer boundary
qn_desc: conductive flux qn = -(K grad u) . n_out
qoi: convergence order of the coupled field, plus the two-sided interface flux jump
